focus_areas: Distinction between water-induced blur and AI melting artifacts
Structural connectivity of flippers to body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus on distinguishing whether the smooth texture of the animal is a result of the underwater environment (light scattering) or an AI failure to render fur. Verify that the flipper shapes are anatomically consistent with Otariidae (sea lions) rather than Phocidae (true seals) using gross morphology only, as fine details are obscured. Prioritize boundary continuity checks over keypoint accuracy.
image_description: An underwater photograph showing a dark-colored marine mammal, identified as a sea lion, swimming in blue water. The animal is viewed from the side/below, with one foreflipper raised and hind flippers trailing. Visibility is reduced due to water turbidity.
